name: JDC
summary: Joshua Dade Contractors Corporation is a family-owned industrial construction and maintenance company established in 1990, having completed over 3,000 projects across Texas. Operating from their Deer Park headquarters, JDC provides comprehensive industrial services including construction, electrical, fabrication, and specialized technical solutions to the petrochemical and industrial sectors.
demographics: The Deer Park area, located in the Houston metropolitan region, attracts a predominantly working-class demographic with strong ties to the petrochemical and industrial sectors. The trade area serves middle-income households with a mix of blue-collar workers, skilled tradespeople, and industrial professionals who value practical services and reliability. Visitors to this location typically prioritize functional business services over retail shopping, with a customer base that includes industrial facility managers, maintenance supervisors, and corporate procurement professionals seeking specialized industrial construction and maintenance solutions.
description: Joshua Dade Contractors Corporation (JDC) has been a cornerstone of industrial construction and maintenance services in Deer Park, Texas since 1990. This family-oriented business operates from their head office at 121 East San Augustine Street, serving the greater Houston industrial corridor with unwavering commitment to quality, customer satisfaction, and consistency. Over more than three decades, JDC has successfully completed over 3,000 projects, establishing themselves as a trusted partner in the industrial construction sector. The company offers comprehensive services including technical and field services, analytical services, instrumentation, electrical work, civil construction, demolition, conveyor systems, fabrication, scaffolding, and even specialized dive division services. With additional corporate facilities in Harlingen, Dayton, and Cypress, Texas, JDC has appointed 870 contractors and built a reputation for delivering quality construction, maintenance, and service that meets budgets while exceeding expectations. Their facility serves as both an operational headquarters and a testament to their expertise in industrial construction and building maintenance.
